concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-in-person-payments-dynamic-currency-conversion]] — 2026-09-15 Adyen for Platforms in-person DCC pilot guide for terminal customer choice, DCC markup allocation between user and liable balance accounts, and dated eligibility/receipt constraints; separate from generic FX fees and the broader POS guide.
warnings: The source's Requirements section certifies Visa/Mastercard/Maestro, while its Supported cards section also lists VPay.
This Platforms guide requires a DCC addendum, while the broader POS guide says no extra contract; preserve their scope and date distinction.
